newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar dominates trade.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar dominates trade.

text.p: Zambia Sugar dominated a week of quiet trade on the Lusaka Stock Exchange, which saw a marginal increase in traded volume over the previous week, exchange officials said.
They said volume rose to 112,388 shares valued at 1,303,446 kwacha, up from 104,653 shares worth 1,510,173 kwacha the previous week.
Zambia Sugar fell three kwacha to end the week at 12 kwacha in a traded volume of 79,633 shares worth 975,596 kwacha.
Rothmans gained one kwacha to end the week at 35 kwacha in a traded volume of 12 shares worth 420 kwacha.
Meanwhile, Zambia Bata Shoe Company Ltd has put on offer, two million shares for sale at 10 kwacha per share, exchange officials said.
